notes.subject: moya
notes.rationale: נפש ke selo se hemago — pela/mokgwa wa bophelo; 'moya' ke bja mo go go swanago, e sego 'moya' wa bohalaleli

notes.subject: go ntšha ⟨moya⟩
notes.rationale: מפח נפש: 'go ntšha moya' (go hema bofelo) ka botlalo — KJV/ASV 'giving up of the ghost'; JPS 'go namela ga pelo'

notes.subject: tshepo
notes.rationale: תקוה e boeletšwa (11:18 le 11:20): tshepo ya Jobo e tšweletša, ya basebe e a hema — khutšo ye e phosago ga e fetolele

translation: Gomme mahlo a basebe a tla fela, gomme mokgwa wa go falola o timetše go ba, le tshepo ya bona ke go ntšha ⟨moya⟩.
